_comment_credentials: Create this login from the dashboard's Staff page — a dedicated account just for the printer, not the owner's own login.
_comment_printer: Leave printerIp empty to use the IP/port saved in Settings > Kitchen ticket printing on the dashboard instead. A value here overrides that.
_comment_paperWidth: Characters per line: 48 for 80mm paper (default), 32 for 58mm paper.
